sources.title: Model Cards for Responsible AI: Stop Carding, Start Modelling
sources.snippet: Complementing these AI Safety approaches, Model Cards were introduced by AI industry major vendors [20] as documentation artifacts intended to support Responsible AI by reporting on model uses, limitations, and evaluation results. However, AI Safety does not use the same semantics for "safety" as the field of safety engineering does.

sources.title: Unorganized machine - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: An unorganized machine is a concept mentioned in a 1948 report by Alan Turing titled " Intelligent Machinery ", in which he suggested that the infant human cortex was what he called an "unorganised machine". [1][2] It remained unpublished until 1969.
